name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is setting out what it wants the European Commission's upcoming white paper on defence to contain. It calls for much more spending on defence, more military aid to Ukraine, joint buying of weapons, faster decision-making, and a stronger European defence industry. It also asks EU leaders to meet and agree urgent decisions.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states demands and opinions.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, defence companies, Ukraine, and EU citizens.
- **What happens next:** EU leaders and the Commission are asked to act on these ideas.
